name: Caterpillar - Athens GA Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (BCP - mini hydraulic excavators, small track-type tractors)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (ROOFTOP, movedMeters 7) sat in woods at a road intersection ~0.7 km SE of the plant. Plant building is just NW. Confirmed via Athens Area Chamber / Panjiva (250 Dozer Dr) and the 850k sq ft / 3-building / 250-acre campus described in web sources. Locked center on the main building at 33.9400,-83.5185.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck/visitor entrance: a guard booth with a canopy over the lane sits on a paved island in the wide entrance road at 33.9412,-83.5154, with a stop sign and a vehicle parked beside it - confirmed in both z21 satellite and 2025 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small staffed booth (~1-2 vehicle footprint, canopy roof) positively imaged at the gate - clear guard shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A long dock face with ~15-20 dock doors and trailers/containers backed in runs along the NW building face; counted from z18-z19 imagery, 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two yard areas: a dock-side trailer/container line on the NW, and a very large finished-goods/equipment yard NE holding rows of new Cat mini excavators and dozers plus parked trailers.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: 3 buildings totaling 850,000 sq ft per Caterpillar/Chamber sources; main plant plus connected wings, retention ponds, large finished-goods yard.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane entrance road with a paved island at the gate gives room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~180 acres for the developed/fenced campus from the perimeter box; the full parcel with wooded buffer is reported as ~250 acres.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.

citations.claim: Caterpillar building $200M, 1M sq ft factory near Athens GA for small track-type tractors and mini hydraulic excavators.
Caterpillar Athens factory operating, hosting plant tours in 2025.

verification.rationale: CAT-built/operated plant making mini excavators and small dozers; opened 2014, still active 2025; no closure found.
